text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's training time, but there's no sign of
Fine
Motion. I'm searching the academy
for her,
when...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Grr... I can't just ignore this news! And
it's not just
Ireland that'll be affected,
but every other nation
as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Do you want to take a
look? These
political articles really are
fascinating, aren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is it that time already? I-I
apologize. I
totally lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I was careless.
I'll be more careful
in future.
choice_data_list: Make sure you read this later.
Make sure to read this later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Fine Motion has taken
things to
heart. I decide not to lecture
her any further.
